scope: Read-only implementation/evidence audit; no new inference or protocol changes. PDF recommendations do not override user-authorized scope.

status_definitions.implemented: The bounded requirement has executable code or a verified generated artifact; this does not certify the full scientific contribution.
status_definitions.partial: Some executable components or results exist, but the requested comparison or report is incomplete.
status_definitions.missing: No executable experiment and corresponding result located in the inspected repository; prose/config names alone do not count.
status_definitions.excluded: Explicitly excluded by the user's current scope; not an implementation failure.

verification_limit: Local report manifest and all seven report output hashes verified. Report aggregates account for 4000 dialogues across 16 cells. Full remote test records and head artifacts were not re-audited because SSH banner exchange timed out; local development reports are available but their remote source records are not mirrored locally.

requirements.evidence: src/tdrl/learning.py; tests/test_core.py; configs/comparison-judge-v2-sample500-seed17.json
requirements.limitation: Current c_step=1 and gamma=1 replace historical appendix parameters; no cosine-bound saturation claim is valid.

requirements.requirement: Directed geometry used for retrieval, graph edges, coverage and leaf scoring
requirements.evidence: src/tdrl/reachability.py; graph.py; planner.py
requirements.limitation: Shared implementation is not evidence that sharing improves performance.

requirements.limitation: Requires a separately authorized model/runtime amendment; current same-family simulation cannot establish this transfer.

requirements.evidence: evaluation.simulator_prompt supports frozen resistant profile
requirements.limitation: No independently specified perturbation grid or performance-change table.

requirements.requirement: Second response-backbone generator transfer
requirements.evidence: User expressly excludes cross-LLM-backbone comparisons; AGENTS.md and EXPERIMENT_PLAN.md
requirements.limitation: Intentional scoped exclusion, not a bug; do not claim generator transfer.

requirements.requirement: Artifact-backed main/ablation/human/mechanism exhibits and coherent venue/paper delivery
requirements.evidence: Scoped JSON/Markdown report exists; tdrl/paper is empty
requirements.limitation: No new paper, required exhibit package, format validation or inspected PDF; guidelines assume WWW while repository method scope says EMNLP 2026.

inconsistencies.finding: Graph goals are pre-response states whose next assistant utterance contains the target string, not independently judged user-acceptance states.
inconsistencies.impact: Distance/path progress is progress toward a target-mention guidance anchor; it cannot by itself be interpreted as distance to successful acceptance.

inconsistencies.finding: Censored cross-trajectory pairs are explicitly pushed to distance >= negative_margin despite no demonstrated unreachability.
inconsistencies.evidence: training.PairSampler samples 25% cross-trajectory negatives; learning.ReachabilityLearner.step applies hinge separation
inconsistencies.impact: Prose says not universally unreachable, but optimization still repels potentially feasible cross-trajectory states. Need validated negatives, sensitivity or narrower interpretation; not proof every negative is wrong.

inconsistencies.finding: Matched Full has generation_call_cap=1 while three branches x two lookahead require a planned 12 calls; recovery is disabled.
inconsistencies.impact: This is a disclosed one-call-cap fallback control, not a useful full-planner matched-compute comparison; calls cap does not match tokens/H100 seconds.

inconsistencies.finding: Dialogue generation totals and wall/H100 seconds include the outcome judge and evaluation user simulator.
inconsistencies.impact: Valid evaluation-loop resource accounting, but cannot be labeled isolated serving cost without role/time separation. Guidelines exclude offline evaluation judges from serving cost.

inconsistencies.finding: PDF describes minimum distance over lookahead; current Full scores final leaf only, with entry distance plus remaining directed path cost in revision 2.
inconsistencies.impact: Document the intentional rebuild difference and compare scorer variants before attributing the historical mechanism to current code. Max negative value and min cost remain equivalent.

inconsistencies.finding: Real dialogues use semantic outcome/refusal judgment, but hypothetical rollout branches stop via lexical refusal and never semantic goal achievement.
inconsistencies.impact: A hypothetical accepted branch may continue and be ranked by reachability instead of acceptance. This is a code-level risk; frequency/causal contribution is not yet measured.

inconsistencies.finding: STATUS.md dated 2026-10-03 still says no H100 smoke, checkpoints, lock or report; EXPERIMENT_PLAN retains original deterministic-acceptance and one-GPU/three-seed/full-test plan.
inconsistencies.evidence: docs/STATUS.md; docs/EXPERIMENT_PLAN.md; complete report manifest and later AGENTS amendments
inconsistencies.impact: Historical snapshots are not authoritative current status. Their assertions conflict with newer artifacts if read as current instructions.

inconsistencies.finding: Full does not guarantee retaining the exact R response as a candidate; candidate 0 and R use different derived seed purposes.
inconsistencies.evidence: planner.py candidate generation versus /final seed path
inconsistencies.impact: Full-versus-R compares a recovery mechanism that also changes realized response candidates. It is not a claim that Full must always win; preserve seeds/budgets when redesigning controls.

intentional_scope_differences: 500 fixed scenarios and one experimental seed supersede PDF approximate 2000-scenario suggestion and old three-seed plan by explicit user request.
User baseline priority is PPDPP/DPDP/TRIP/DiffTOD; PDF also recommends ProCoT/EnPL/T-EPL/SCOPE. Do not silently expand or relabel baseline scope.
Cross-backbone comparison is excluded; different-family simulator study is outside current pinned local-Qwen runtime contract.
Current debugging focuses MRN only; retain IQE historical evidence rather than claim current exhaustive head comparison.
Guidelines' historical cosine and Bellman parameters are review context, not current runtime specifications.
WWW positioning in the PDF and EMNLP 2026 in AGENTS require a venue decision before paper delivery; this audit does not change the venue.
priorities: Finish MRN discovery diagnostic and validate leaf/goal semantics using the frozen local judge before another planner change.
Implement identical-prefix paired intervention with independent continuations; do not substitute full-dialogue scenario pairing.
Implement own-history early-prefix failure prediction and controlled support removal.
Generate missing turn/denominator/role-separated cost summaries from immutable traces; add random/always routing controls at meaningful measured budgets.
Prepare pilot/power and institutional human-study determination; no label collection until approved.
